summary: My project is a website which can suggest rover manufactures or space agencies for comaptable test areas on Earth.This can help space organisations to help them prepare for all outcomes.I have collected Earth data from "Earth data download" and Mars and Moon data from Mars trek and Moon trek.
details:
Rover Site Matcher helps teams choose where on Earth to test a rover before it flies to the Moon or Mars. Enter your rover’s limits: steepest slope, how much of a site must be drivable, highest latitude, and elevation limits. The tool then marks which parts of the Moon, Mars or Earth fit it. It ranks the compatible tiles. For any Moon or Mars tile, it also lists the closest Earth terrain, so engineers can find a test site that behaves like the real one.

It is built on public NASA and USGS data: LRO LOLA for the Moon (118 m), MGS MOLA for Mars (463 m), and NASADEM for Earth. The Moon and Mars are each split into 14,400 tiles of 2°, and 539 Earth tiles are compared. Surface temperature from MODIS and MERRA-2 climate data is gathered for four example Earth sites.
